dex.text: Crawls up Long Beach after dark, digs a hole with its back flippers and sulks about it for the rest of the night. The sand is warm underfoot. It thinks that is only fair.
dex.fact: Green turtles cross about 2,000 kilometres of open Atlantic from Brazil to nest on Ascension, and return to the same beaches, often near where they hatched, years later.

dex.text: A shell the colour of cooled cinder, cracked with orange where it has lately been thinking about something. Has crossed an ocean to be on this one beach and will not discuss it.
dex.fact: A nesting female green turtle can lay several clutches in a season, about a hundred eggs each, buried in the sand to be warmed by the sun; the warmth of the nest decides whether hatchlings are male or female.
